svg.title: Event loop
svg.desc: Chat messages from 8,000 WebSockets become callbacks that one event loop thread runs one at a time. First the export handler runs JSON.stringify on 60 MB on the loop, so for hundreds of milliseconds nothing else runs, the queue piles up, and heartbeats are late. Then the export is handed to a worker thread, and the loop keeps running chat callbacks until the worker posts back a download link.
svg.text: One slow callback stalls everyone. A worker thread keeps the loop free.
